title: Do Rats Never Get Cancer?

scenes.text: A 2015 study showed a lab rat lived 2 years without tumors.
Many think rats are immune to cancer, making them perfect lab subjects.
scenes.label: Rats immune to cancer

scenes.text: Rats do develop tumors naturally; researchers actually induce cancers in them to study treatments.
scenes.label: Rats can develop cancer

scenes.text: They’re useful because we can control cancer, not because they’re immune.
scenes.label: Controlled model
scenes.sub: Scientists create tumors to test therapies.

scenes.text: Follow for a mind-blowing fact every day.

description: Rats aren’t cancer‑free superheroes; they’re just adaptable lab models. Discover the real reason they’re used in oncology research.
